description: Thin TypeScript wrapper around ZEVM with pluggable WASM and native EVM backends, viem v2 clients, and Solidity bundler plugins.
rules: TEVM is a thin wrapper around ZEVM with a pluggable ZevmBackend interface ({ rpc, close }) that supports plugging in WASM-based EVMs as well as ZEVM's native addon.
Use createMemoryClient({ backend }) or createZevmEngine({ backend }) to plug in a WASM EVM or custom JSON-RPC runtime, or omit backend to use the default @evmts/zevm runtime in Node.js, Bun, or Deno.
Browser clients can plug in a WASM EVM backend directly via ZevmBackend or connect to a running TEVM server over HTTP/WebSocket JSON-RPC using viem v2 transports.
Use createMemoryClient() for viem v2 public, wallet, test, and TEVM actions, and call tevmClose() when finished.
